title: TDOA Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TDOA_Position_Estimator.md
text: 根据到达时间差估计目标位置，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Output covariances of TDOA position estimates} 指定 TDOA 位置估计的输出协方差、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: TDOAEst
ports.summary: 估计的到达时间差（秒） ( L –1)-element real-valued vector

ports.name: TDOAVar
ports.summary: 到达时间差的估计方差（秒平方） ( L –1)-element real-valued vector

ports.name: AnchorPos
ports.summary: Anchor positions (meters) 2-by- L real-valued matrix | 3-by- L real-valued matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: 目标位置估计 real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: 目标位置协方差矩阵 real-valued positive semi-definite Q -by- Q matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst("LightSpeed") (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output covariances of TDOA position estimates
params.values: TDOA 位置估计的输出协方差 false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
